title: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
abstract: arXiv:2610.27334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose EMBER, a structure-based framework for TCR--pMHC binding prediction that eliminates the need for a predicted docked complex, and with it the placement error that dominates such predictions. Traditional structure-based predictors utilize the co-folded complex structure of the receptor and the antigen and interpret binding from its contact surface. Consequently, every downstream feature inherits any deviation the structure-prediction tool introduced. Methodologically, EMBER folds the TCR and pMHC independently, encodes them as SE(3)-invariant residue graphs, and compares their learned representations without constructing a shared coordinate frame. A relative pose is therefore not an input of the model, so placement error cannot propagate into the prediction. translated_title: EMBER：无需对接复合物的TCR-pMHC结合预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出EMBER，这是一个基于结构的TCR-pMHC结合预测框架，它消除了对预测对接复合物的需求，从而消除了主导此类预测的放置误差。传统的基于结构的预测器利用受体和抗原的共折叠复合物结构，并从其接触面来解释结合。因此，每一个下游特征都会继承结构预测工具所引入的任何偏差。在方法学上，EMBER独立地折叠TCR和pMHC，将它们编码为SE(3)不变的残基图，并在不构建共享坐标系的情况下比较它们学习到的表示。因此，相对位姿不再是模型的输入，放置误差也就无法传播到预测中。在计算上，EMBER需要预处理O(N+M)个单体折叠，而基于复合物的预测器则需要O(NM)次运算。在实验上，在表位不相交的评估下……（摘要原文此处被截断）
tldr: EMBER通过独立折叠TCR和pMHC并将其编码为SE(3)不变的残基图进行比较，无需构建对接复合物即可预测TCR-pMHC结合，从而消除了放置误差的传播，并将计算复杂度从O(NM)降低到O(N+M)。
